upstream_decisions.decision: Headerless residues; original discretization/export transformation is not established. Smaller physics/chandra4 has rational coefficients but no derivation metadata. Excluded.
Headerless one-based export. Use independent primary family definition at N=4 and N=8 instead.
Headerless residue-like coefficients without original model/parameter provenance. Do not lift them to other characteristics. Excluded.
Headerless one-based integer equations scaled by 10. Use the documented Noonburg parameter 11/10 at N=3 and N=6, generated independently.
Headerless zero-based integer power sums. Use the independently documented alternating-power family at N=3 and N=5.
Original model identifier is in the filename; parameter specialization and algebraic preprocessing are not documented in this repository. Fourteen variables, and provenance unresolved; excluded.
Original molecular-model derivation and third-party data terms are not documented here. Excluded; no candidate bytes redistributed.
Declared variable order differs from alphabetical order. Original source/third-party data terms are not documented here; excluded in favor of three independently defined families.
